assistworld-assist-world:lever:943b3fb6-.description: About the Company Maison Apothecare is a direct-to-consumer skincare brand founded in 2012, built on homeopathic and botanical formulations focused on skin longevity. The brand has a loyal base of roughly 25,000 customers and a focused 30-SKU collection. It is intentionally D2C-only — the founder previously grew a separate retail brand and wants to avoid the cost and complexity of retail partnerships this time around. Maison Apothecare has taken a backseat to that other brand in recent years, and the founder is now refocused on growing it significantly using the customer base and channels already in place. About the Role The founder has been the strategist, marketer, and operator behind this brand from day one, and is now looking for someone who can genuinely step into that role — not assist with it. This person will be the single point of ownership for turning the brand's existing 25,000-customer base into significantly higher revenue, with real authority to set direction and real accountability for the results. It is a senior, entrepreneurial seat, not an entry point into D2C. The Scope, at a Glance • Strategy & Customer Insight — owning a deep, ongoing analysis of the Shopify store (customers, order frequency, top products, seasonality) and turning it into a clear growth plan • Team Leadership — directing and unifying the work of an in-house content creator, a newsletter specialist, and a soon-to-be-hired SEO/Google Ads specialist, so all three are working from one consistent strategy • Customer Experience — owning day-to-day customer service (~5 emails/day) and review engagement on the Judge.me app, maintaining the personal customer connection that has driven the brand's success to date • Inventory & Forecasting — using Shopify's AI tools to monitor stock and forecast production needs across the 30-SKU collection • Reporting & Accountability — providing clear, goal-oriented updates to the founder and owning measurable progress against revenue targets What We're Looking For • A proven, hands-on track record growing a D2C brand through website, social, and email/newsletter channels — this is not a role for transferable skills only • Comfortable being directly accountable for revenue growth, not just activity — the budget for this role is a real stretch for the business today, and the founder needs confidence this person can earn it back • An entrepreneurial, independent problem-solver who can work through most challenges before needing input • Senior enough to direct other contributors without heavy oversight from the founder • Genuine enthusiasm for customer connection and brand-building — not just task execution • Clear, proactive communicator who can report on goals, progress, and results • Comfortable balancing big-picture strategy with hands-on daily execution in the same day Why This Role This is a rare opportunity to take full ownership of a brand with an established, loyal customer base and clear room to grow — not a narrow lane within someone else's strategy. The founder has done this work herself and knows exactly what's needed; she's looking for a true partner with the seniority to make real decisions and the drive to be measured on real results. Why Join Assist World? 100% REMOTE $50 birthday bonus $200 testimonial bonus $500 entry monthly raffle NO TRACKER. NO PROBLEM!

bloomon-bloomon:lever:d2139751-3a4e-426f.title: Customer Support Senior Associate (Dutch or German Speaking)
bloomon-bloomon:lever:d2139751-3a4e-426f.description: bloomon is turning the flower industry on its head – for the better. How? By disrupting the traditional supply chain! We skip the auction and wholesale, to shorten the journey for our flowers. And we harness technology, brand and innovation to deliver gifts and subscriptions that delight our customers across Europe. We launched in Amsterdam in 2014, and in 2021 joined forces with Bloom & Wild, the UK's fastest growing ecommerce company (according to the Financial Times). Our group is backed by top tier investors and is now home to a family of 3 strong brands, Bloom & Wild, bloomon and Bergamotte. Together, we’ve delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. Our vision is to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us. 🛠️ Customer Delight Team @ Bloom & Wild Group With the same care we are watering our flowers and arranging our beautiful bouquets, we are looking after our customers and helping them out. Are you customer obsessed and put the customer’s experience first in everything you do? Do you enjoy solving complex problems for a variety of stakeholders? Can you motivate your team members while being strategic about daily inbox KPIs? Do you have a growth mindset and enjoy applying your insights to different challenges? Are you proactive, resourceful and thrive in a fast-paced dynamic environment? Can you connect dots and enjoy spotting and solving issues before they become problems? Join our Customer Delight Team as a Senior Associate and bring joy to customers' and our teams’ days with every interaction! In this role, you'll focus on supporting both our bloomon and Bloom & Wild brands delivering exceptional customer service that leaves a lasting impression. As a part of the Senior Customer Delight team, on a daily basis you will support our customers via the management of the inbox and deliver a variety of operational tasks. You will also be responsible for helping the team meet our targets and OKRs via peaks and projects, process improvement and implementation, coaching and training agents while consistently modelling care, initiative and critical thinking. In addition to this you will support in the inbox, requiring flexibility and adaptability to meet diverse customer needs. You will solve email, chats and Whatsapps at a high volume from all our markets (we have an excellent translation tool) and support on phone calls in English and German or Dutch. Working on a high volume of tickets with example-leading quality is especially important over peak periods. You will also support complex and escalated tickets and review the quality of agents’ work with an expert and empathetic approach. It is essential that you can think in a solution-oriented way and are able to work independently. For this position, it is also a must that you are empathetic and can put yourself in our customers' and agents’ shoes. You will carry out varied work and be given a lot of responsibility straight away. Being organised, proactive and ready to hit the ground running will be essential to success in the role.

Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! jobgether-jobgether:lever:4c7fd748-41ac-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business and Management Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Saudi Arabia. This freelance opportunity is designed for business and management professionals who want to contribute their expertise to the development of advanced AI systems. You will help evaluate and improve how AI models understand business strategy, organizational behavior, operations, and management decision-making. The work involves challenging models with realistic business scenarios, analytical questions, and strategy-focused exercises. You will assess whether responses are logically sound, practically applicable, and aligned with real-world business practices. Your feedback will help identify reasoning gaps, recurring errors, and situations where AI oversimplifies complex organizational processes. The role combines business expertise, critical thinking, structured evaluation, and clear written communication in a flexible freelance environment. Evaluate AI-generated responses for logical consistency, business accuracy, practical applicability, and alignment with real-world organizational practices. Identify and document model failure modes, reasoning gaps, oversimplifications, and misunderstandings of business processes. Capture clear, reproducible error traces that can be used to improve model evaluation and training. Provide structured and actionable feedback on prompts, responses, evaluation frameworks, and reasoning quality. Analyze business cases and decision-making frameworks to determine whether AI models can appropriately apply concepts in realistic contexts. Challenge model assumptions and assess how effectively AI handles nuanced business strategy, operational efficiency, market positioning, and organizational decision-making. Clearly articulate your reasoning and decision processes, including the factors that lead to particular business judgments or conclusions. Contribute insights that help improve AI systems designed to support business professionals, organizations, planning, analysis, and decision-making. launchtn-pilot-3-208c6413-9fd2-4901-97c9.description: The Role Pilot spent ten years building the software that powers its own bookkeeping operation, delivering books for thousands of clients. Now, we’re packaging this system as Meridian and making it available to all accounting firms. We’re hiring an engineering manager to help make this future a reality. We’re looking for a caring, empathetic engineering manager with a technical background who is excited to build and ship software iteratively. We value being close to our customers, iterating quickly, and learning from what we ship. Our teams operate on high trust, and we value ownership over the outcomes you’re responsible for: building a great system that supports our customers. This role is for the Infrastructure team, which is responsible for core infrastructure, developer experience, the design system, frontend infrastructure, and security. Our tech stack: Pilot’s backend is written in fully typed Python 3.13, and our frontend is JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue.js. We use Terraform to manage our production infrastructure, and deploy Docker containers to ECS. AWS CodeDeploy powers our deployments and we rely on Honeycomb for our monitoring and Postgres as our database. This is a remote position managing a remote team distributed across the United States. Key Responsibilities Lead a team of talented engineers who like to ship code and tackle hard engineering problems. Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of your team members. Help develop their careers, and assign them to projects tailored to their skill levels, personalities, work styles, and professional goals. Create a team environment that values collaboration, inclusion, and respect. Provide continuous feedback, address performance, and recognize the individual strengths and contributions of your team members. Create plans for prioritizing technical and resourcing challenges within the team, within the context of the larger Engineering organization. As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), Michigan Institute of Urology (MIU) is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven physician-led urology network. This partnership empowers MIU to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Practice Opportunities: Employed Position with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Why Michigan Institute of Urology? At MIU, we pride ourselves on delivering cutting-edge urological care in a collaborative, physician-led environment. As part of our team, you’ll have the chance to work with top-tier professionals, leverage advanced technology, and shape the future of urology in Michigan. Whether you’re a general urologist or bring specialized expertise, MIU offers a platform to grow your career while making a lasting impact on our patients’ lives. What You’ll Do: Provide comprehensive urological care, from diagnosis to treatment, for a diverse patient population with varied needs. Perform a mix of surgical and outpatient procedures in state-of-the-art facilities, balancing clinical excellence with patient care. Collaborate with a talented team of urologists, advanced practice providers, and support staff in a supportive, team-oriented setting. Enjoy a thoughtfully designed schedule that promotes both professional success and personal well-being. Who We’re Looking For: A board-certified or board-eligible urologist with strong skills in Urologic Oncology and General Urology . A compassionate, patient-centered physician with excellent interpersonal and communication skills. A collaborative team player eager to contribute to our practice’s mission and growth. A proactive professional committed to staying at the forefront of urological advancements. Why Choose Michigan Institute of Urology? Growth & Impact: Join us during an exciting phase of expansion, with multiple openings by 2027 driven by patient demand and practice development. Reputation for Excellence: Be part of a trusted name in urology, known for high-quality care across Southeast Michigan. Cutting-Edge Tools: Access advanced technology and modern facilities to deliver the best possible outcomes for your patients. Career Support: Enjoy mentorship, professional development opportunities, and a robust compensation package with comprehensive benefits. Community Overview - Troy, MI: Troy, Michigan is a thriving suburban community located in the heart of Metro Detroit, offering an excellent combination of professional opportunities, quality amenities, and convenient access to the surrounding region. Known for its highly regarded schools, diverse neighborhoods, and strong business community, Troy is an attractive place for professionals and families alike. Residents enjoy an impressive selection of shopping and dining, including the popular Somerset Collection, as well as numerous parks, trails, golf courses, and recreational facilities. The city’s central location provides convenient access to downtown Detroit and many of Southeast Michigan’s major employment, entertainment, and cultural destinations. With its welcoming neighborhoods, abundant amenities, and exceptional quality of life, Troy offers an ideal setting to live, work, and build a long-term career. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:05ee9513-d7f.description: Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries. At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You’ll Need - Native or near-native fluency in Yoruba - Based in: Nigeria, Remote - English proficiency - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI. Depending on your skills, you might: 📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems 🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance 💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs) 🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you. How to Apply? Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community. 📬Questions? If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.
